facts.name: Japanese Painted Fern
facts.light: Part shade to shade; moist soil
facts.notes: A showy fern with silver-gray fronds and burgundy stems. It brightens the shade and pairs well with coral bells and brunnera.

sources.title: English Gardens (Michigan garden center): Japanese Painted Fern

companions.why: Contrasts nicely with Japanese painted fern; combines well with astilbes, bleeding heart and Heuchera.
